import datetime, math
# login to venmo
venmo_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_access=apis.venmo.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']
print('venmo_access_token_head', venmo_access[:10])
# get current date
now=datetime.datetime.now()
year=now.year
min_created_at=f'{year}-03-01'
max_created_at=now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print('date_range', min_created_at, max_created_at, 'year', year)
# roommate contacts from earlier
roommates=[
 {'first_name':'Anthony','last_name':'Harrison','email':'an-harrison@gmail.com','phone_number':'2466064078'},
 {'first_name':'Anita','last_name':'Burch','email':'anita.burch@gmail.com','phone_number':'3643463570'},
 {'first_name':'Melissa','last_name':'Bailey','email':'mel.bailey@gmail.com','phone_number':'3383946795'},
]
print('roommate_emails', [r['email'] for r in roommates])

# function to page through transactions and sum

def fetch_sum_for_email(user_email, direction):
    total=0.0
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_access, user_email=user_email, min_created_at=min_created_at, max_created_at=max_created_at, direction=direction, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('email', user_email, 'direction', direction, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(res) if isinstance(res, list) else 'N/A')
        if not res:
            break
        for t in res:
            # amount might be string/number
            total += float(t['amount'])
        page_index += 1
    return total

sent_tot=0.0
recv_tot=0.0
per={}
for r in roommates:
    email=r['email']
    s=fetch_sum_for_email(email,'sent')
    rv=fetch_sum_for_email(email,'received')
    per[email]={'sent':s,'received':rv,'total':s+rv}
    sent_tot+=s
    recv_tot+=rv

print('per', per)
print('sent_tot', sent_tot, 'recv_tot', recv_tot, 'combined', sent_tot+recv_tot)
